harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the load-balanced HTTP service. Nginx serves node identifiers from node1–node3 on port 5660; HAProxy serves node4 port 80 with round-robin balancing and HTTP health checks. Service remained available during a node2 backend outage and fully recovered afterward.
actions_performed: Installed, configured, enabled, and started Nginx on node1, node2, and node3.
Configured HAProxy on node4 with all three backends, round-robin balancing, and health checks.
Verified healthy request distribution across all three backends.
Stopped node2 Nginx, verified continued service through node1/node3, then restored node2.
Confirmed all configurations are valid and all services are active and enabled.

evidence.requirement: Each backend serves its node identifier from port 5660
evidence.summary: Each managed-node IP returned its matching identifier and showed Nginx listening on port 5660.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends
evidence.summary: HAProxy was active on port 80, returned node1/node2/node3 in round-robin order, and had valid health-checked backend configuration.

evidence.requirement: Service remains available when one backend fails
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline; stopped node2 and confirmed its endpoint was unreachable; all eight degraded-state requests succeeded via node1/node3; restored node2; then observed all three backends serving again.

evidence.requirement: Final recovered and persistent service state
evidence.summary: All Nginx and HAProxy services finished active, enabled, and configuration-valid with correct direct responses and listeners.
